normative_composition.rule: Load and hash all three artifacts. The P1342 R2 contract is normative through the exact R3 composition. Every P1342 clause remains intact except the heuristic allowed-diff-boundary/source-evidence mechanism explicitly named in replaced_p1342_clauses. The P1343 binding composes the unchanged 19-row R2/R3 binding by exact hashes and indices, then supplies the only valid 36-capsule join. Conflict, missing predecessor, unknown schema/key, row drift or ambiguous precedence is Violated.
replaced_p1342_clauses: p1342-contract-spec-r3.candidate_checker_contract.validation_order steps 3-5 only where they use generic allowed-diff boundaries
normative_composition.replacement: The lexical scanner, inverse_normalization, source_structure, externally_pinned_invocation and source_evidence_schema clauses in this contract are the sole replacement. Historical baseline hashes are compared only after complete inverse normalization of live candidate bytes.
preserved_p1342_obligations: exact 19 rows and 18 applicable hooks per origin cell with H00D/H00S exclusivity
closed event, role, typed-value, raw snapshot, append receipt and DTO schemas
fresh verifier-controlled challenges and challenge-bound identity namespace
exact append receipt formula and one append-only raw writer
session and occurrence carrier continuity through every real edge
same real Location and continuous snapshot-pre/snapshot-post
attempt-kind, R definitions, cardinalities, ordering and late-append rules
normal, repeat and reverse fresh execution and disjoint identity rules

l0_assessment.reason: The ten frozen L0 owners already require the private cfg-only carrier, ledger, hooks and test facade. P1343 changes only how the acceptance layer proves authorized source changes; it does not change public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase.

in: deterministic source binding for H00D, H00S and H01-H16
36 frozen capsules in ten frozen consumers
runtime coverage of the 178-byte fixture in fresh normal, repeat and reverse runs
out: general retention, discard, invalidation or terminal policy
public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase change

closed_world.unknown_members: Every contract, binding, capsule manifest, verifier evidence, runtime object and DTO is closed at every depth. Duplicate JSON keys, unknown keys, missing keys, wrong primitive types, bool-as-int, noncanonical hash/base64, NaN/infinity or unknown enum values are Violated.
closed_world.path_policy: All repository paths are exact case-sensitive POSIX-relative allowlist members. Absolute paths occur only as verifier-controlled CLI roots. Dot segments, NUL, path aliases, symlinks in an allowlisted file or any canonical target outside the supplied root are Violated.

lexical_scanner.input: Raw bytes of each of the ten exact allowlisted live files, read directly below the verifier-controlled candidate root.
lexical_scanner.encoding: Require UTF-8, LF line endings, no UTF-8 BOM, no CR and no NUL. Failure is Violated.
states: RawString with exact hash delimiter count
ByteString and RawByteString with exact prefix/delimiter rules
CString and RawCString with exact prefix/delimiter rules
lexical_scanner.state_rule: Scan bytes left to right using Rust lexical delimiter rules. A marker is eligible only when its physical line begins in Code, consists of optional ASCII space/tab followed by one exact line comment marker and optional ASCII space/tab, and then LF or EOF. Marker-looking bytes inside strings, raw strings, chars, block comments, an already-open line comment, doc comments, byte strings/chars or text emitted/reconstructed by a macro are never markers.
lexical_scanner.region: A capsule byte region begins at byte zero of the BEGIN physical line, including indentation, and ends immediately after the END line LF, or at EOF when END is the final unterminated line. The body is the bytes strictly between the two complete marker lines.
lexical_scanner.pairing: Reject END without an open BEGIN, BEGIN while another capsule is open, mismatched IDs, duplicate IDs, overlap, nesting, an unknown ID, an ID in the wrong file or EOF with an open capsule. Each of the 36 manifest IDs must occur exactly once globally and exactly once in its declared file. Enumerate all regular .rs files below 01_core, 02_shell, 03_infra and 04_wiring without following symlinks and run the same lexical scanner; any eligible P1343 marker outside the ten allowlisted files is Violated.
lexical_scanner.order: Discovery order never carries authority. After validation, records are keyed by exact capsule_id and normalization uses descending begin byte offset per file, with capsule_id as a deterministic tie-breaker that can never be exercised because overlap/equal offsets are already Violated.

algorithm: 1. Rehash and closed-parse the contract, binding, authority manifest, capsule baseline, L0 freeze, fixture and composed P1342 contracts/bindings from verifier-controlled pins.
2. Strictly decode and rehash every replacement and anchor, rehash the ten candidate-free whole-file pins represented by the capsule manifest, and validate the exact 19-row-to-36-capsule join.
3. Read each live file directly from candidate root and run lexical_scanner; never consume DTO ranges, marker lists, hashes or booleans.

4. For each capsule require its exact manifest anchor_before bytes immediately before the capsule region and anchor_after bytes immediately after it. Derive all offsets and candidate body hashes from those live bytes.
5. Replace each complete live capsule region with its strict-base64-decoded baseline_replacement bytes in descending live offset order.

6. In the normalized file require anchor_before || baseline_replacement || anchor_after exactly once for every declared capsule and require the complete normalized file SHA-256 to equal its exact baseline_file_sha256.
7. Emit derived evidence in manifest file order, capsule manifest order and row_index order.
inverse_normalization.insert_rule: The decoded replacement must be zero bytes with SHA-256 e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. Every non-whitespace Rust syntax node in the body must be dominated by the exact manifest required_cfg attribute; cfg! runtime branching, cfg_attr that can remove the guard, an unguarded use/type/field/statement or an alternate productive path is Violated.
inverse_normalization.replace_rule: The body must contain exactly one normal syntax branch dominated by #[cfg(not(p1339_observation))] and exactly one observed branch dominated by the exact required_cfg. After removal of only the normal branch's cfg attribute and any single syntactic wrapper required to attach that attribute, the normal payload must contain the decoded baseline_replacement as one exact contiguous byte sequence and no other effective normal-path tokens. The observed branch must be mutually exclusive. Missing, duplicated or altered normal payload, cfg! branching or effective normal behavior outside that exact payload is Violated.
inverse_normalization.whole_file_proof: A live hash unequal to the candidate-free hash is expected. Acceptance equality is normalized_file_sha256 == baseline_file_sha256 after the fixed inverse transformation. Equality of live and baseline hashes cannot satisfy missing capsules or hooks.
inverse_normalization.fail_closed: Any anchor mismatch, replacement mismatch, normalized hash mismatch, scanner ambiguity, unsupported lexical construct or inability to prove the exact transformation is Violated, never Unknown. SequenceMatcher, edit distance, diff hunk/range union and alignment heuristics are forbidden.

source_structure.source_of_truth: Live bytes, the protected capsule manifest and the unchanged composed P1342 rows. Candidate DTO/facade/evidence declarations are untrusted hints at most.
source_structure.owner_resolution: Using Rust lexical tokens with balanced (), [] and {}, resolve module::name at file module scope; Type at its exact struct/tuple-struct declaration; impl Type at an exact impl body; Type::method at the exact inherent method body; a free function at its exact fn body; eval_expr::Expr::Dict at the exact Expr::Dict match arm in eval_expr; and apply_func::FuncRepr::With at the exact FuncRepr::With arm in apply_func. Resolve each manifest symbol exactly once. An unsupported or ambiguous resolution is Violated.
source_structure.row_binding: For every composed row, resolve its exact P1342 path, symbol, branch, anchor_needle, relative_position and expected_matches_in_symbol. Join exactly the capsule IDs in binding.row_capsule_bindings. Each capsule and its exact before/after anchors must lie within the declared owner symbol or named branch and each real observation call/transport must occupy the inherited relative position. A shared support capsule may be referenced by multiple rows but exists once.
source_structure.cfg_rule: Parse cfg attributes as token trees, canonicalize commutative all operands only for comparison, and require semantic identity to p1339_observation or all(test,p1339_observation) exactly. Extra any/not/feature operands, cfg(test) alone, cfg_attr, macro-generated markers/hooks and dead or different branches are Violated.
source_structure.source_hashes: Compute live whole-file, complete capsule, body, normalized file, resolved symbol, inherited anchor and immediate observation adjacency hashes directly from bytes. A candidate-provided copy never authenticates them.
source_structure.syntax_gates: Source proof is necessary but not a general Rust parser. Before candidate acceptance, cargo test --no-run with the observation cfg, cargo build without observation cfg and rustfmt --check over all ten consumers must independently pass. A self-attested parse_ok field is never evidence.

externally_pinned_invocation.authority: The A/B tester, preseal verifier or final verifier supplies every path, hash, candidate root and challenge outside candidate control. The DTO and p1342_run_fixture_for_test may supply only raw runtime/projection data and may not select, embed, rewrite or authenticate any contract, baseline, verifier, source-evidence path/hash/root or verdict.
externally_pinned_invocation.rehash_rule: Both source verifier and checker rehash every supplied artifact before parsing. The checker independently reads the same candidate root, reruns lexical scanning, inverse normalization, row/capsule joins and source facts, then requires its canonical derived source projection to equal the externally pinned evidence. It never accepts evidence booleans in place of recomputation.
externally_pinned_invocation.root_rule: Canonicalize candidate root once without following symlinks. Open the ten exact relative paths for full source proof. Separately enumerate regular .rs files only below 01_core, 02_shell, 03_infra and 04_wiring for the global eligible-marker exclusion; reject symlinks, traversal and unreadable entries rather than skipping them. Candidate root identity is recorded from verifier-controlled HEAD plus byte hashes of the exact ten files, not from --version or DTO text.

source_evidence_schema.canonicalization: UTF-8 RFC 8785 JSON with a single trailing LF; reject duplicate keys before canonicalization.
source_evidence_schema.cardinality: Exactly ten file records in capsule-baseline file order, 36 capsule records in capsule-baseline order, 19 row records in row_index order, one writer_projection and one runtime_coverage. Arrays inside them are closed by the protected binding and composed P1342 row/runtime schemas.

runtime_and_writer_evidence.writer: Rust-aware source inspection must find exactly one encapsulated append-only raw-ledger writer. Enumerate every callsite and map it to the exact row/capsule. Any alternate writer, direct raw vector mutation, receipt rewrite, prefix mutation or post-hoc event/receipt constructor is Violated.
runtime_and_writer_evidence.projection: Enumerate every raw-to-DTO projection symbol. They may read only the immutable H16 snapshot; zero append, receipt, event, identity, order or payload writes are allowed. Rehash the same raw snapshot before and after projection.
runtime_and_writer_evidence.runtime: Using the protected 178-byte fixture, execute three fresh World/Source/challenge runs in normal, repeat and reverse modes. Coverage is derived from actual raw preprojection append receipts and matched to every composed row and its capsules. Enforce H00D/H00S exclusivity and all inherited per-cell/R cardinalities, causal order, carriers, Location, snapshots, typed Dict values and spans.
runtime_and_writer_evidence.freshness: The three 32-byte challenges are verifier-controlled, pairwise distinct and supplied only after each fresh run is ready. Worlds, Sources, ledgers and serialized identity sets are fresh and identity sets are pairwise disjoint. Fixed IDs, reused ledger or post-hoc rechain is Violated.
runtime_and_writer_evidence.facade: p1342_run_fixture_for_test is the sole authorized test facade name, exists only in P1343-TEST-FACADE under all(test,p1339_observation), receives the verifier challenge and returns raw preprojection plus DTO runtime data. It may not run the source verifier, choose source paths/hashes, fabricate coverage or contain the protected P01 fixture bytes.

precedence: 1. Rehash and closed-parse every protected/verifier-supplied artifact and validate exact P1342 composition plus P1343 row/capsule join.
2. Independently scan live bytes, validate all marker/anchor/cfg/owner facts, inverse-normalize all ten files and require every whole normalized hash.
3. Validate syntax/build gates, exact source hooks, one writer, no post-hoc constructor, read-only projection and runtime reachability/coverage.

4. Validate fresh challenges, raw receipt algebra, frozen boundary, schemas, identities, carrier/endpoint/Location/snapshot continuity, cardinalities, spans, typed values and causal ordering under the intact P1342 contract.
5. Only after steps 1-4 all pass may an explicitly authored opaque dict-witness with valid commitment classify Unknown. Otherwise a fully inspectable valid case is Preserved.
classification.violated: Any missing, stale, malformed, candidate-controlled, ambiguous or false protected input, capsule, marker, anchor, cfg, owner, hook, facade, source fact, normalized hash, compile gate, writer/projection fact, runtime evidence or P1342 non-payload predicate is Violated with the first deterministic public reason_code.
classification.unknown: Unknown is allowed only for the deliberate opaque dict-witness payload already authorized by P1342 after every structural, source, runtime and non-payload predicate passes. Scanner/parser uncertainty, absent evidence, unsupported syntax, hidden identity or budget exhaustion is never Unknown.
classification.preserved: Preserved requires all structural/source/runtime predicates and an inspectable valid payload. Deterministic normalization alone is not Preserved; live==baseline without capsules/hooks is Violated.

determinism.ordering: Protected arrays are evaluated in declared order: ten files, 36 capsules and row_index 0..18. Runtime cases use authored order for normal/repeat and reversed authored order only for reverse. Diagnostic witness selection is lexicographically first tuple (phase, path, capsule_id, row_index, reason_code).
determinism.repetition: For identical bytes, challenges and runtime evidence, two invocations must emit byte-identical canonical derived source projections and identical classifications/reason_codes. Reordering JSON object keys, independent input case order or filesystem enumeration must not alter the verdict.
determinism.race: No mutable global cache, clock, environment-dependent source selection, filesystem enumeration, runtime address or process ordering may affect classification. Any observed nondeterminism is Violated and blocks seal.

checker_algorithm: Require every verifier-controlled CLI argument and rehash its bytes before parsing; reject paths/hashes obtained only from DTO/facade.
Closed-validate this contract, binding, authority manifest, capsule baseline, L0 freeze, fixture and exact P1342 predecessors/composition.
Require the fixture to be exactly 178 bytes, LF-terminated and equal to its protected hash.

Invoke or import the pinned source verifier only with the supplied candidate root/runtime evidence, then independently reexecute lexical scanning, inverse normalization and all source-derived checks over the same live bytes.
Require canonical recomputed source projection equality with the pinned source evidence; ignore self-attested booleans as proof.
Apply intact P1342 raw/runtime rules to raw preprojection and DTO outputs, join actual receipts to the exact row/capsule records, then classify using classification.precedence.
Repeat deterministic controls and produce a closed witness. Never infer success from absence of a parser error, from a live whole-file hash, or from a candidate-declared range/hash/result.

required_discrimination.positive: A syntactically valid candidate that contains exactly all 36 real capsules, normalizes all ten files to the protected baseline hashes, binds all 19 rows at their real owners, has one writer/read-only projection and satisfies the full P1342 runtime contract is Preserved when inspectable.
required_discrimination.candidate_free_control: An unchanged candidate-free tree is Violated because all required capsules, hooks, facade and runtime coverage are absent, even though its ten hashes equal the historical baseline.
required_discrimination.opaque: A deliberately opaque dict-witness after all other predicates pass is Unknown and no other opacity case is Unknown.
mandatory_negative_classes: all valid P1342 A01-A21 and later X/Y/Z negatives, including fixed IDs and post-hoc rechain
marker-looking bytes in normal string, raw string, byte string, char or nested block comment
unknown, missing, duplicate, mismatched, nested or overlapping capsule
capsule in wrong file, owner symbol, branch or cfg
false replacement bytes or changed anchor
one byte changed outside every capsule
insert with an unguarded syntax node
replace with absent, altered or active observed normal branch
invalid Rust plus self-attested parse success
empty or decoy capsule over changed source
forged source, anchor, symbol, writer, projection or runtime hashes/booleans
live baseline equality with fabricated hooks or coverage
required_discrimination.mutation_score: valid negative cases classified Violated divided by all valid negative cases; required value 1.0. A relevant survivor blocks seal.

red_and_implementation_gate.order: No productive candidate before a preseal pins this contract, binding, source verifier, corpus and full discriminatory receipt with score 1.0. After seal, the independent A/B tester freezes a new P1343 test before seeing candidate code; only then may implementation begin.
red_and_implementation_gate.red: The reissued test uses the protected 178-byte fixture, three fresh World/Source/challenges, the exact facade name, raw preprojection and DTO runtime data, and verifier-controlled source inputs. Candidate-free must fail specifically for absent facade/hook, without a full corpus run.
red_and_implementation_gate.candidate_write_scope: Only bodies of the exact 36 capsules in ten allowlisted files, plus the separately assigned test include switch, may change. Required work outside that finite scope stops the chain.
red_and_implementation_gate.normal_behavior: Observation additions remain cfg-only; replace capsules retain the exact normal payload. Observation must not execute an extra callback or alter product result/control flow. Normal build without p1339_observation is mandatory.

requirements: independent source verifier and focal oracle authored from this contract without candidate
independent adversary attacks all inherited and new capsule classes
author focal calibration passes without full corpus execution
one independent full preseal execution classifies positives Preserved, deliberate opaque Unknown and every valid negative Violated
normal, repeat, reverse, repetition, reordering and race controls agree
preseal pins all protected inputs, verifier, corpus, outputs and score
seal_gate.invalidation: Any protected hash change, relevant survivor, authority write violation, ambiguous classification, nondeterminism or score below 1.0 prevents or invalidates SEALED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.

budget_and_stop.stop: Stop after two focal attempts with the same classification vector and public cause; when a required edit cannot fit the 36 capsules and recover the ten baseline hashes; when a protected input or authority boundary changes; when ADR-0127 is implicated; or when progress would require weakening a negative, trusting candidate evidence or broadening scope. Budget never converts failure or Unknown into success.

forbidden_acceptance: Generic diff/range-union proof, heuristic alignment or candidate-declared allowed boundary.
Live candidate whole-file equality with historical baseline as either necessary or sufficient acceptance.
Candidate/DTO/facade selection or authentication of contract, baseline, verifier, root, source evidence or verdict.
Text-only hook matching, cfg(test) decoy, macro reconstruction, dead branch or unsupported scanner state treated as success/Unknown.
Missing capsule/hook/evidence, false replacement, outside byte, altered normal branch or syntax failure treated as Unknown.
Multiple writer, direct raw mutation, post-hoc construction, projection write, extra callback, global side table or name/output/address lookup.
Weakening any P1342 row, event, carrier, identity, receipt, Location, snapshot, R/cardinality, typed-value, span, ordering or B01-B05 obligation.
Claim of equivalence beyond the focal binding or closure of P1340, NT01-NT06, retention or terminal policy.
